title: The seaside
alt: A busy British beach with a pier, boats, people, rock pools, beach huts and a small brown bear wearing a navy scarf.

sounds.text: Listen for s in sand. Look near the sand.
sounds.spoken: Listen for the s sound in sand. Look near the sand.

words.text: Look by a hut. Sound out hut.
words.spoken: Look by a hut. Sound out hut: h, u, t.

digraphs.text: Check the huts near the shore. Listen for sh.
digraphs.spoken: Check the huts near the shore. Listen for sh in shore.

hint: Look beside the red beach hut.
